en.name: SSD drive 2.5" Micron 960GB 5400 Pro SATA (6 Gb/s)
en.shortDescription: Micron 5400 Pro enterprise SSD 960 GB 2.5" SATA 6 Gb/s for servers and storage. A reliable replacement for aging HDDs. Buy in Tashkent with warranty.
en.description:
Micron 5400 Pro solid-state drive with a capacity of 960 GB in a 2.5" form factor with a SATA 6 Gbit/s interface — an enterprise SSD for servers and data storage systems requiring high reliability and stable performance. Designed to replace outdated hard drives in servers and laptops, providing a significant increase in data access speed. An ideal solution for organizations transitioning to solid-state drives in corporate infrastructure.

## Advantages
- No moving parts: the SSD operates silently and is resistant to vibration, which increases reliability in server conditions
- Significantly higher read and write speed compared to traditional HDDs when working with random data blocks
- The enterprise class of the Micron 5400 Pro series is optimized for mixed read/write workloads in server applications
- The 2.5" form factor and SATA 6 Gbit/s interface ensure compatibility with existing server infrastructure without replacing the chassis
- The 960 GB capacity is sufficient for the operating system, applications and working data in server configurations
- Reduces power consumption and heat generation compared to HDDs of similar capacity

## Applications
- Database and application servers with intensive input/output operations
- Replacement of boot HDDs in existing servers to speed up the operation of the operating system
- Virtualization systems where disk speed affects the performance of virtual machines
- Corporate workstations and servers with a high load on the disk subsystem

## FAQ
Q: What is the advantage of the enterprise Micron 5400 Pro SSD over a consumer SSD?
A: Enterprise SSDs are designed for continuous 24/7 operation, have a higher write endurance and advanced data protection features that are not provided in consumer models.
Q: Can this SSD be installed instead of an HDD in a standard server slot?
A: Yes, the 2.5" form factor and SATA interface are standard — the drive is installed without additional adapters in most servers and NAS systems.
Q: What is the warranty on this SSD?
A: The warranty period is 1 year.

tr.name: SSD sürücü 2.5" Micron 960GB 5400 Pro SATA (6 Gb/s)

Micron 5400 Pro 960 GB kapasiteli, 2.5\" form faktörlü ve SATA 6 Gbit/s arabirimli katı hal sürücüsü — yüksek güvenilirlik ve istikrarlı performans gerektiren sunucular ve veri depolama sistemleri için kurumsal bir SSD'dir. Sunuculardaki ve dizüstü bilgisayarlardaki eski sabit diskleri değiştirmek için tasarlanmıştır ve verilere erişim hızında önemli bir artış sağlar. Kurumsal altyapıda katı hal sürücülerine geçen kuruluşlar için ideal bir çözümdür.

## Avantajları
- Hareketli parça yoktur: SSD sessiz çalışır ve titreşime dayanıklıdır, bu da sunucu koşullarında güvenilirliği artırır
- Rastgele veri bloklarıyla çalışırken geleneksel HDD'lere kıyasla önemli ölçüde daha yüksek okuma ve yazma hızı
- Micron 5400 Pro serisinin kurumsal sınıfı, sunucu uygulamalarında karma okuma/yazma yükü için optimize edilmiştir
- 2.5\" form faktörü ve SATA 6 Gbit/s arabirimi, şasi değişimi olmadan mevcut sunucu altyapısıyla uyumluluğu sağlar
- 960 GB kapasite, sunucu konfigürasyonlarında işletim sistemi, uygulamalar ve çalışma verileri için yeterlidir
- Benzer kapasiteli HDD'lere kıyasla enerji tüketimini ve ısı yayılımını azaltır

## Uygulama alanları
- Yoğun giriş-çıkış işlemleri olan veritabanı ve uygulama sunucuları
- İşletim sisteminin çalışmasını hızlandırmak için mevcut sunuculardaki açılış HDD'lerinin değiştirilmesi
- Disk hızının sanal makinelerin performansını etkilediği sanallaştırma sistemleri
- Disk alt sistemine yüksek yük binen kurumsal iş istasyonları ve sunucular

## FAQ
Q: Kurumsal SSD Micron 5400 Pro'nun tüketici SSD'sine göre avantajı nedir?
A: Kurumsal SSD'ler kesintisiz 24/7 çalışma için tasarlanmıştır, daha yüksek yazma dayanıklılığına ve tüketici modellerinde bulunmayan gelişmiş veri koruma işlevlerine sahiptir.
Q: Bu SSD'yi standart bir sunucu yuvasına HDD yerine takabilir miyim?
A: Evet, 2.5\" form faktörü ve SATA arabirimi standarttır — sürücü çoğu sunucuya ve NAS sistemine ek adaptör olmadan takılır.
Q: Bu SSD'nin garantisi nedir?

zh.name: SSD 固态硬盘 2.5" Micron 960GB 5400 Pro SATA (6 Gb/s)
zh.shortDescription: Micron 5400 Pro 企业级 SSD 960 GB 2.5" SATA 6 Gb/s，适用于服务器和存储。老旧 HDD 的可靠替代品。塔什干有售，带保修。
zh.description:
Micron 5400 Pro 960 GB 2.5" SATA 6 Gbit/s 固态硬盘 —— 面向需要高可靠性和稳定性能的服务器及数据存储系统的企业级 SSD。专为替换服务器和笔记本中过时的机械硬盘而设计，可显著提升数据访问速度。是企业基础设施向固态硬盘过渡的机构的理想之选。

## 优势
- 无活动部件：SSD 运行无声且抗振动，在服务器环境中提升可靠性
- 在处理随机数据块时，读写速度相比传统 HDD 显著更高
- Micron 5400 Pro 系列企业级针对服务器应用的混合读写负载进行了优化
- 2.5" 尺寸和 SATA 6 Gbit/s 接口确保与现有服务器基础设施兼容，无需更换机箱
- 960 GB 容量足以容纳服务器配置中的操作系统、应用和工作数据
- 相比同容量 HDD 降低功耗和发热

## 应用领域
- 输入输出操作密集的数据库和应用服务器
- 替换现有服务器中的启动 HDD 以加速操作系统运行
- 磁盘速度影响虚拟机性能的虚拟化系统

- Ikkita Xeon Silver 4514Y protsessori koʻp vazifali muhitlar uchun yuqori hisoblash quvvatini taʼminlaydi

en.name: Server Supermicro SYS-221H-TN24R: 2× Xeon Silver 4514Y, 128Gb DDR5-4800 (4×32Gb), 2× SSD 480Gb (2.5” SATA)
en.shortDescription: Supermicro SYS-221H-TN24R server 2U: 2× Xeon Silver 4514Y, 128 GB DDR5-4800, 2× SATA SSD 480 GB. Expansion and cooling for demanding workloads. In stock.
en.description:
Supermicro SYS-221H-TN24R server — a powerful dual-processor 2U platform with Intel Xeon Silver 4514Y processors, 128 GB DDR5-4800, and two 480 GB SATA SSDs. The larger 2U form factor delivers better expansion and cooling capabilities compared to 1U platforms, making the server optimal for workloads with high demands on the number of drives and expansion cards. The solution is aimed at enterprise customers building a scalable and modern server infrastructure.

## Advantages
- Two Xeon Silver 4514Y processors deliver high computing power for multitasking environments
- 128 GB of DDR5-4800 memory (4×32 GB) provides high next-generation bandwidth
- The 2U form factor opens up more expansion slots and drive bays for storage scaling
- Two 480 GB SATA SSDs form fast and reliable primary storage
- The Supermicro platform guarantees industrial-grade reliability and a broad ecosystem of compatible components
- A 1-year warranty on the complete server protects the investment

## Applications
- Data storage servers with an expandable disk array
- Virtualization platforms with high I/O requirements
- Enterprise file servers and backup systems
- Centralized video recording storage systems with a large number of cameras

## FAQ
Q: What is the difference between the 1U (SYS-121C) and 2U (SYS-221H) versions?
A: The 2U offers more expansion slots, drive bays, and better cooling, making it suitable for workloads with high storage and bandwidth requirements.
Q: Does the server support hot-swappable drives?
A: Hot-swap capabilities depend on the specific chassis configuration; check with SAT Solutions specialists.
Q: Can the RAM be expanded in the future?
A: Yes, Supermicro platforms typically have a substantial reserve of slots for memory expansion — check the details with our engineers.

Çözüm, ölçeklenebilir ve modern sunucu altyapısı kuran kurumsal müşterilere yöneliktir.

## Avantajları
- İki adet Xeon Silver 4514Y işlemci, çok görevli ortamlar için yüksek hesaplama gücü sağlar
- 128 GB (4×32 GB) DDR5-4800 bellek, yeni nesle ait yüksek bant genişliği sunar
- 2U form faktörü, depolama ölçeklendirmesi için daha fazla genişletme yuvası ve disk yuvası açar
- İki adet 480 GB SATA SSD, hızlı ve güvenilir bir ana depolama oluşturur

- Genişletilebilir disk dizisine sahip veri depolama sunucuları

- Çok sayıda kameralı merkezi video kaydı depolama sistemleri

## FAQ
Q: 1U (SYS-121C) ve 2U (SYS-221H) sürümleri arasındaki fark nedir?

uz.name: Tarmoq kartasi LR-Link 1 port 10/100/1000Base-T LREC9201CT

uz.description:
Bitta 10/100/1000Base-T portli LR-Link LREC9201CT tarmoq kartasi — serverda yoki ishchi stansiyada gigabit tarmoq interfeysini qoʻshish yoki almashtirish uchun ishonchli yechim. Karta 1 Gbit/s gacha tezlikda barqaror simli ulanishni taʼminlaydi, bu koʻpchilik korporativ vazifalar uchun yetarli: maʼlumot uzatish, maʼlumotlarni saqlash tizimiga ulanish, serverlarni boshqarish. Standart PCIe interfeysi tufayli server va ish stoli platformalarining keng doirasi bilan mos keladi.

- 10/100/1000Base-T ni qoʻllab-quvvatlash istalgan tarmoq infratuzilmasi bilan toʻliq orqaga moslikni taʼminlaydi
- Bitta RJ-45 port boʻsh oʻrnatilgan portlarsiz serverga gigabit tarmoq interfeysini tezda qoʻshish imkonini beradi

- Ishchi stansiyalar va serverlardagi ishdan chiqqan tarmoq adapterini almashtirish
- Maʼlumotlar markazidagi serverlar uchun alohida boshqaruv interfeysini tashkil etish

Q: Karta qaysi operatsion tizimlar bilan mos keladi?

Q: Ulanish uchun maxsus kabellar kerakmi?
A: Yoʻq, karta RJ-45 ulagichli standart Cat5e yoki Cat6 kabellari bilan ishlaydi.
Q: Bitta serverga shunday bir nechta kartani oʻrnatish mumkinmi?
A: Ha, boʻsh PCIe slotlari mavjud boʻlsa, kanallarni birlashtirish yoki qoʻshimcha tarmoq interfeyslari yaratish uchun bir nechta kartani oʻrnatish mumkin.

en.name: Network card LR-Link 1 port 10/100/1000Base-T LREC9201CT
en.shortDescription: LR-Link LREC9201CT network card with 1 port 10/100/1000Base-T for servers and workstations. Stable gigabit over twisted pair. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The LR-Link LREC9201CT network card with a single 10/100/1000Base-T port is a reliable solution for adding or replacing a gigabit network interface in a server or workstation. The card provides a stable wired connection at speeds up to 1 Gbit/s, which is sufficient for most enterprise tasks: data transfer, connecting to storage, and server management. It is compatible with a wide range of server and desktop platforms thanks to the standard PCIe interface.

## Advantages
- Support for 10/100/1000Base-T ensures full backward compatibility with any network infrastructure
- A single RJ-45 port lets you quickly add a gigabit network interface to a server without free built-in ports
- The standard RJ-45 connector works with ordinary Cat5e/Cat6 category cable without special transceivers
- The compact form factor and low power consumption place no load on the cooling system
- The LR-Link brand specializes in network cards and is known for reliability in the enterprise segment
- A 1-year warranty confirms the quality of the component base

## Applications
- Expanding the network capabilities of servers with an insufficient number of built-in ports
- Connecting video surveillance servers to the corporate network or storage network
- Replacing a failed network adapter in workstations and servers
- Setting up a separate management interface for servers in a data center

## FAQ
Q: Which operating systems is the card compatible with?
A: Most LR-Link gigabit cards support Windows Server, Linux, and VMware ESXi; check the specific drivers with our specialists.
Q: Are special cables needed for the connection?
A: No, the card works with standard Cat5e or Cat6 cables with an RJ-45 connector.
Q: Can several such cards be installed in a single server?
A: Yes, with available PCIe slots you can install several cards for link aggregation or to create additional network interfaces.

tr.name: Ağ kartı LR-Link 1 port 10/100/1000Base-T LREC9201CT
tr.shortDescription: LR-Link LREC9201CT ağ kartı, 1 port 10/100/1000Base-T ile sunucular ve iş istasyonları için. Burgulu çift üzerinden kararlı gigabit. Taşkent'te satın alın.
tr.description:
Tek 10/100/1000Base-T portuna sahip LR-Link LREC9201CT ağ kartı — bir sunucuya veya iş istasyonuna gigabit ağ arabirimi eklemek ya da değiştirmek için güvenilir bir çözümdür. Kart, 1 Gbit/s'ye kadar hızda kararlı kablolu bağlantı sağlar; bu da çoğu kurumsal görev için yeterlidir: veri aktarımı, depolama sistemine (SAN/NAS) bağlantı, sunucu yönetimi. Standart PCIe arabirimi sayesinde geniş bir sunucu ve masaüstü platform yelpazesiyle uyumludur.

## Avantajları
- 10/100/1000Base-T desteği, herhangi bir ağ altyapısıyla tam geriye dönük uyumluluk sağlar
- Tek RJ-45 portu, boş yerleşik portu olmayan bir sunucuya hızlıca gigabit ağ arabirimi eklemeye olanak tanır
- Standart RJ-45 konnektör, özel alıcı-vericiler olmadan sıradan Cat5e/Cat6 kategorili kablo ile çalışır
- Kompakt form faktörü ve düşük güç tüketimi, soğutma sistemine yük bindirmez
- LR-Link markası ağ kartları konusunda uzmanlaşmıştır ve kurumsal segmentteki güvenilirliğiyle tanınır
- 1 yıl garanti, bileşen tabanının kalitesini doğrular

## Uygulama alanları
- Yerleşik port sayısı yetersiz olan sunucuların ağ olanaklarının genişletilmesi
- Video gözetim sunucularının kurumsal ağa veya depolama ağına bağlanması
- İş istasyonları ve sunuculardaki arızalı ağ adaptörünün değiştirilmesi
- Veri merkezindeki sunucular için ayrı bir yönetim arabiriminin oluşturulması

## FAQ
Q: Kart hangi işletim sistemleriyle uyumludur?
A: LR-Link gigabit kartlarının çoğu Windows Server, Linux ve VMware ESXi'yi destekler; belirli sürücüler için uzmanlarımıza danışın.
Q: Bağlantı için özel kablolara ihtiyaç var mı?
A: Hayır, kart RJ-45 konnektörlü standart Cat5e veya Cat6 kablolarla çalışır.
Q: Bir sunucuya birden fazla bu karttan takılabilir mi?
A: Evet, boş PCIe yuvaları bulunması durumunda, kanal birleştirme veya ek ağ arabirimleri oluşturmak için birden fazla kart takılabilir.

zh.name: 网卡 LR-Link 1 端口 10/100/1000Base-T LREC9201CT
zh.shortDescription: LR-Link LREC9201CT 网卡，配备 1 个 10/100/1000Base-T 端口，适用于服务器和工作站。双绞线上稳定的千兆。塔什干有售。

- 扩展内置端口数量不足的服务器的网络能力

## FAQ

A: 不需要，该网卡可使用带 RJ-45 接口的标准 Cat5e 或 Cat6 电缆。
Q: 一台服务器可以安装多块这样的网卡吗？
A: 可以，在有空闲 PCIe 插槽的情况下，可安装多块网卡用于链路聚合或创建额外的网络接口。

uz.name: Tarmoq kartasi LR-Link 1 port 10GBase-X LREC9801BF-SFP+

- 10 Gbit/s gacha tezlik tor joylarsiz katta hajmdagi maʼlumotlarni barqaror uzatishni taʼminlaydi

en.name: Network card LR-Link 1 port 10GBase-X LREC9801BF-SFP+
en.shortDescription: LR-Link LREC9801BF-SFP+ network card with 1 port 10GBase-X for an SFP+ transceiver, for servers and workstations. 10 Gb/s fiber. Buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The LR-Link LREC9801BF-SFP+ network card is a single-port adapter with a 10GBase-X interface for connecting SFP+ transceivers. It is designed for servers and workstations that require a high-speed optical or direct connection to the network infrastructure. The card is ideal for upgrading a server fleet without replacing the entire platform.

## Advantages
- Speeds up to 10 Gbit/s ensure stable transfer of large data volumes without bottlenecks
- The SFP+ slot lets you choose the connection type: multimode or single-mode optical cable, as well as DAC cables
- The compact single-port form factor takes up minimal space in the chassis and suits servers with a limited number of expansion slots
- Compatible with a wide range of operating systems and hypervisors
- A 1-year warranty confirms the component's reliability in long-term operation
- Easy integration into an existing 10G network infrastructure

## Applications
- Data storage servers and NAS systems requiring a high-speed network channel
- Data centers and enterprise server rooms
- Video surveillance and video analytics with centralized storage of high-resolution streams
- Virtualization platforms with network bandwidth requirements
- Connecting servers to 10G aggregation switches

## FAQ
Q: Which transceiver is suitable for this card?
A: The card is equipped with an SFP+ slot compatible with standard 10G transceivers — the choice of module depends on the cable type and the distance to the switch.

Q: Can the card be used in video surveillance systems?
A: Yes, the 10G adapter is well suited for servers that process and store video streams from numerous high-resolution IP cameras.

Q: Does the card support Link Aggregation?

en.name: Network card LR-Link 2 4 ports 1000Base-X/10GBase-X LREC9804BF-4SFP+

en.description:
The LR-Link LREC9804BF-4SFP+ network card is a four-port adapter supporting the 1000Base-X and 10GBase-X standards via SFP+ connectors. This is a solution for servers that need high network connection density: four independent ports allow you to build fault-tolerant and high-performance configurations without additional equipment costs.

## Advantages
- Four SFP+ ports in a single card increase connection density and save server expansion slots
- Support for 1GbE and 10GbE enables flexible connection to network infrastructure of different generations
- The ability to combine ports for link aggregation and increased fault tolerance
- Compatibility with standard SFP+ transceivers and DAC cables simplifies the choice of optics
- Suitable for tasks requiring several high-speed network segments simultaneously
- A 1-year warranty provides confidence in stable operation under constant load

## Applications
- Virtualization servers with several virtual networks and high bandwidth requirements
- Data storage systems with separate management and data transfer interfaces
- Video surveillance nodes collecting streams from a large number of IP cameras
- Fault-tolerant clusters with link aggregation
- Enterprise server platforms with network traffic segmentation tasks

## FAQ
Q: Can the card be used with different speeds on each port simultaneously?
A: Yes, each port operates independently and supports both 1GbE and 10GbE depending on the installed transceiver.

Q: Is the card suitable for building a fault-tolerant network?
A: Yes, the four ports allow you to configure LACP or bonding for link aggregation and redundancy at the operating system level.

Q: Is the card compatible with Linux-based servers?
A: The card is supported by most Linux server distributions; to confirm compatibility, check the kernel version with our specialists.

en.name: Network card LR-Link 2 ports 10/100/1000Base-T LREC9712HT
en.shortDescription: LR-Link LREC9712HT dual-port network card 10/100/1000Base-T for connecting servers to Ethernet over twisted pair. Reliable gigabit without fiber. In stock.
en.description:
The LR-Link LREC9712HT network card is a dual-port copper adapter supporting 10/100/1000Base-T for connecting servers to a standard Ethernet infrastructure over twisted pair. The card is designed for tasks that require a reliable gigabit connection without switching to optical cable, making it a convenient and cost-effective solution for enterprise and small server environments.

## Advantages
- Two independent gigabit RJ-45 ports let you simultaneously connect to different network segments or configure link redundancy
- Support for automatic 10/100/1000 Mbit/s speed negotiation simplifies integration into existing infrastructure
- Operation over standard Cat5e/Cat6 twisted pair without the need to lay optics
- A cost-effective solution for servers requiring additional network interfaces
- Compatible with a wide range of server operating systems
- A 1-year warranty ensures reliability in everyday operation

## Applications
- Small and medium business servers with a limited budget for network infrastructure
- Network channel redundancy in server systems
- Connecting management servers to separate administrative VLANs
- Workstations and servers in entry-level and mid-range video surveillance systems
- Training centers and lab benches requiring additional ports

## FAQ
Q: Is the card suitable for connecting to ordinary office switches?
A: Yes, the copper RJ-45 ports are compatible with any standard gigabit switches without additional transceivers.

Q: Can the two ports be combined into a single logical channel?
A: Yes, operating systems allow you to configure bonding or LACP to aggregate both ports into a single channel with increased bandwidth and fault tolerance.

Q: What is the maximum cable run length for this card?
A: When using Cat5e twisted pair and higher, the standard range is up to 100 meters.

en.description:

This is a solution for next-generation server platforms for which 10G is no longer sufficient, but a full transition to 40G or 100G is not justified. The 25-gigabit ports provide a significant bandwidth boost at reasonable infrastructure costs.

## Advantages
- A speed of 25 Gbit/s per port — the optimal balance of performance and cost for modern server environments
- Two independent SFP28 ports allow you to aggregate channels or provide redundant connection to switches
- Compatibility with standard SFP28 transceivers and DAC cables simplifies the choice of optics

## Applications

- Data storage systems with high bandwidth requirements
- Video analytics and AI servers with intensive data exchange
- Enterprise data centers transitioning to 25G infrastructure
- Cluster computing configurations with low-latency requirements

## FAQ
Q: Is the card backward compatible with 10G equipment?
A: Compatibility depends on the switch and transceiver; the SFP28 standard is physically compatible with SFP+ connectors, however the speed is limited by the capabilities of the switch port.

Q: For which tasks should you choose 25G instead of 10G?
A: If the server processes large volumes of data — virtual machines with intensive network traffic, high-resolution video streams, or machine learning tasks — 25G provides a noticeable boost without switching to costly 40G infrastructure.

Q: Which PCIe slot is required to install the card?

- Four SFP28 ports with 25 Gbit/s bandwidth each — high interface density in a single PCIe slot

- 配置灵活：链路聚合、冗余、按网段分流流量
- 适用于采用 25G 基础设施的新一代服务器
- 适配器质保 1 年

## 应用领域
- 高负载虚拟化服务器和超融合系统
- 数据交换密集的机器学习与人工智能平台
- 采用 25G 交换基础设施的企业数据中心
- 对峰值吞吐量有要求的存储系统
- 集中处理视频流的大规模视频监控系统

## FAQ
Q: 四个 SFP28 端口相比两个 QSFP+ 40G 端口有何优势？
A: 四个独立的 25G 端口在流量路由和冗余方面更灵活，聚合后的总吞吐量与 40G 方案相当或更高。

Q: 该网卡能否通过 SFP28 端口与 10G 交换机配合使用？
A: 物理上 SFP28 兼容 SFP+ 接口，但此时速率受限于交换机端口能力；要以 25G 运行则需配相应的交换机。

Q: 能否将四个端口分配给多台虚拟机？
A: 可以，借助 SR-IOV 或网络虚拟化技术，可将单个端口分配给特定虚拟机。

en.name: Network adapter Broadcom BCM957412A4120AC 2x10GbE (10/1GbE) SFP+
en.shortDescription: Broadcom BCM957412A4120AC 2x10GbE SFP+ network adapter with 1/10GbE support for server platforms. High network throughput, buy in Tashkent.
en.description:
The Broadcom BCM957412A4120AC network adapter is a dual-port solution with 10GbE interfaces via SFP+ connectors, providing support for 1GbE and 10GbE speeds depending on the transceiver. The adapter is built on a Broadcom chip — one of the world's leading manufacturers of network controllers — and is aimed at server platforms with requirements for reliability, broad compatibility, and high performance.

## Advantages
- Two SFP+ ports support optical and direct cable connections at 1G and 10G speeds
- The Broadcom chip provides broad compatibility with server operating systems and hypervisors
- The ability to aggregate two ports to increase bandwidth and fault tolerance
- Support for advanced network stack offload features (TOE, TSO, RSS) reduces the load on the server processor
- A reliable hardware base from a recognized global manufacturer
- A 1-year warranty

## Applications
- General-purpose servers with requirements for high compatibility and reliability
- Enterprise server environments with VMware, Hyper-V, or KVM hypervisors
- Data storage systems with optical 10G connections
- Security and video surveillance servers with intensive network traffic
- Server clusters with load balancing tasks

## FAQ
Q: Why choose an adapter based on a Broadcom chip for an enterprise server?
A: Broadcom is one of the most supported manufacturers of network controllers: drivers for their chips are included in most server OSes and hypervisors out of the box, which simplifies deployment and reduces compatibility risks.

Q: Does the adapter support network stack offload features?
A: Yes, Broadcom chips traditionally support hardware offload features (TSO, LRO, RSS), which reduces CPU load during high network activity.

Q: Which transceivers are compatible with the SFP+ ports?
A: The SFP+ ports support standard 10G transceivers for multimode and single-mode optics, as well as direct attach DAC cables.

## Uygulama alanları

Q: Kurumsal bir sunucu için neden Broadcom çipli bir adaptör seçilmeli?
A: Broadcom, en çok desteklenen ağ denetleyicisi üreticilerinden biridir: çiplerine ait sürücüler çoğu sunucu işletim sistemine ve hipervizöre hazır olarak dahildir; bu da dağıtımı kolaylaştırır ve uyumluluk risklerini azaltır.

Q: Adaptör ağ yığını boşaltma işlevlerini destekliyor mu?

Q: SFP+ portlarıyla hangi alıcı-vericiler uyumludur?
A: SFP+ portları, çok modlu ve tek modlu optik için standart 10G alıcı-vericileri ve doğrudan bağlantı DAC kablolarını destekler.

en.name: Network adapter Broadcom BCM957416A4160C 2x10GbE (10/1GbE) 10GBASE-T
en.shortDescription: Broadcom BCM957416A4160C 2x10GbE 10GBASE-T network adapter for servers with Cat6A copper wiring, 1/10GbE speeds over twisted pair. In stock with warranty.
en.description:
The Broadcom BCM957416A4160C network adapter is a dual-port solution with copper 10GBASE-T interfaces, supporting 1GbE and 10GbE speeds over twisted pair. This is a convenient choice for server environments where copper Cat6A cable is already laid and there is no need to switch to optical infrastructure, but the bandwidth needs to be raised to the 10 Gbit/s level.

## Advantages
- Two 10GBASE-T ports over twisted pair eliminate the need for transceivers and optical cables
- Automatic 1GbE and 10GbE speed negotiation simplifies integration into a mixed infrastructure
- Operation over existing Cat6A copper cable reduces infrastructure modernization costs
- The Broadcom chip guarantees broad compatibility with server OSes and hypervisors
- Support for hardware network stack offload to reduce the load on the processor
- A 1-year warranty on the adapter

## Applications
- Servers with an existing Cat6A copper infrastructure requiring a transition to 10G
- Enterprise server environments with traditional cabling
- Video surveillance systems and data storage servers without an optical infrastructure
- Small and medium data centers gradually modernizing the network to 10G
- Workstations with intensive data transfer tasks

## FAQ
Q: What is the difference between 10GBASE-T and SFP+ adapters?
A: 10GBASE-T runs over standard twisted pair and does not require additional transceivers, which reduces costs when cabling infrastructure is in place; SFP+ requires optics or DAC, but provides greater distances and lower power consumption.

Q: What cable is needed for operation at 10 Gbit/s?
A: For 10GBASE-T, a Cat6A cable or higher is required; standard Cat5e supports only up to 1 Gbit/s.

Q: Is the adapter supported in VMware ESXi?
A: Broadcom chips have native support in most ESXi versions; to confirm compatibility with a specific hypervisor version, consult our specialists.

Broadcom BCM957416A4160C ağ adaptörü — bükümlü çift kablo üzerinden 1GbE ve 10GbE hızlarını destekleyen bakır 10GBASE-T arabirimlerine sahip iki portlu bir çözümdür. Bu, Cat6A bakır kablonun zaten döşendiği ve optik altyapıya geçmeye gerek olmadığı ancak bant genişliğinin 10 Gbit/s seviyesine çıkarılması gereken sunucu ortamları için kullanışlı bir seçimdir.

## Avantajları
- Bükümlü çift kablo üzerinden iki 10GBASE-T portu, alıcı-vericilere ve optik kablolara olan ihtiyacı ortadan kaldırır
- 1GbE ve 10GbE otomatik hız uyumlandırma, karma altyapıya entegrasyonu kolaylaştırır
- Mevcut Cat6A bakır kablo üzerinden çalışma, altyapı modernizasyonu maliyetlerini azaltır
- Broadcom çipi, sunucu işletim sistemleri ve hipervizörlerle geniş uyumluluk garanti eder
- İşlemci üzerindeki yükü azaltmak için ağ yığını donanımsal boşaltma desteği
- Adaptör için 1 yıl garanti

## Uygulama alanları
- 10G'ye geçmesi gereken, zaten mevcut Cat6A bakır altyapısına sahip sunucular
- Geleneksel kablo döşemesine sahip kurumsal sunucu ortamları
- Optik altyapısı olmayan video gözetim sistemleri ve veri depolama sunucuları
- Ağı kademeli olarak 10G'ye modernize eden küçük ve orta ölçekli veri merkezleri
- Yoğun veri aktarımı görevlerine sahip iş istasyonları

## FAQ
Q: 10GBASE-T ile SFP+ adaptörleri arasındaki fark nedir?
A: 10GBASE-T standart bükümlü çift kablo üzerinden çalışır ve ek alıcı-vericiler gerektirmez; bu da kablo altyapısı varsa maliyetleri azaltır; SFP+ ise optik veya DAC gerektirir, ancak daha büyük mesafeler ve daha düşük güç tüketimi sağlar.

Q: 10 Gbit/s hızda çalışmak için hangi kablo gerekir?
A: 10GBASE-T için Cat6A veya üzeri kablo gereklidir; standart Cat5e yalnızca 1 Gbit/s'ye kadar destekler.

Q: Adaptör VMware ESXi'de destekleniyor mu?
A: Broadcom çipleri çoğu ESXi sürümünde yerel desteğe sahiptir; belirli hipervizör sürümüyle uyumluluğu doğrulamak için uzmanlarımıza danışın.

Q: 10GBASE-T 与 SFP+ 适配器有何区别？

- 180° panorama with no blind zones: two lenses form a single stitched image of a wide space
- 8 MP resolution: detail sufficient for clear identification of people and objects across the full width of the scene
- H.265 codec: efficient compression reduces network load and decreases archive size
- WizMind full-color night vision: AI technologies improve image quality in low-light conditions
- IP67 class: complete protection against dust and water exposure during outdoor operation
- 12 V power: a standard power option for convenient integration into existing infrastructure

## Applications
- Wide corridors and passageways: a single view of the space without seams and blind corners
- Retail floors and showcase lines: monitoring along long counters and shelving
- Entrance areas: capturing all entering and exiting visitors in a single frame
- Building perimeter: panoramic monitoring of facades and adjacent areas
- Production lines: a view of extended assembly or packaging sections

## FAQ
Q: What is WizMind technology and how does it differ from ordinary cameras?
A: WizMind is a Dahua platform with advanced AI algorithms: intelligent recognition of people and vehicles, behavior analysis, and other video analytics built directly into the camera.
Q: How is the image from the two lenses stitched?
A: The camera programmatically combines the streams of the two sensors into a single 180° panorama in real time; the result is displayed in the VMS as one video stream.

- WizColor technology: full-color night vision without IR illumination — natural colors in the dark

- Dual-channel video: simultaneous recording and broadcasting of two streams for different tasks
- Two-way audio communication: the ability to talk to the monitored area through the camera

## Applications
- Construction sites: monitoring work progress and guarding materials without connection to utilities
- Country plots and farms: video surveillance at facilities without fixed electricity and internet
- Temporary events and mobile security posts: rapid deployment without major works
- Remote industrial facilities: oil and gas wells, substations, power transmission lines
- Perimeters in hard-to-reach places: monitoring plot boundaries with data transfer over 4G

## FAQ

Q: Which 4G operator is supported in Uzbekistan?

Dahua IPC-HDW1431T1 is an outdoor dome IP camera with 4 MP resolution and a motorized varifocal 2.8–12 mm lens. A wide dynamic range of WDR 120 dB and IR illumination up to 50 m provide quality imaging at any time of day, while the IP67 protection rating guarantees reliable operation in challenging weather conditions. The model is ideal for sites where flexible field-of-view adjustment is required without replacing the lens.

## Advantages
- 4 MP resolution: a detailed picture for reliable identification of objects and faces
- Motorized 2.8–12 mm lens: remote adjustment of field of view and focus without physical access to the camera
- IR illumination up to 50 m: a clear black-and-white image at a considerable distance in night conditions
- WDR 120 dB: a balanced image in mixed lighting — shadows and bright areas are visible simultaneously in the frame
- H.265+ codec: minimal video stream size with high recording quality
- IP67: full dust and moisture protection for outdoor operation

## Applications
- Perimeters of sites with a large protected area: flexible field-of-view adjustment for a specific territory
- Entrance gates and checkpoints: monitoring of vehicles and personnel at any time of day
- Warehouses and industrial enterprises: surveillance in open areas with variable lighting
- Banks and financial institutions: detailed recording for security needs
- Government sites and institutions: reliable perimeter monitoring

Q: Can the camera's field of view be changed after installation?
A: Yes, the motorized lens allows the field of view and focus to be changed remotely through the NVR or software interface without climbing up to the camera.

Q: How does WDR work when capturing an entrance area?
A: WDR 120 dB technology compensates for the brightness difference between the outdoors and indoors, allowing objects to be clearly seen both in shadow and against a brightly lit background simultaneously.

Q: Is the camera compatible with recorders from other manufacturers?
A: The camera supports the ONVIF protocol, which ensures compatibility with most modern network video recorders.

- 守护区域较大的设施周界：针对具体区域灵活调节视角
- 出入大门和检查站：全天候监控车辆和人员
- 仓库和工业企业：在光照变化的开阔区域进行监视
- 银行和金融机构：用于安防的细致录像
- 政府设施和机构：可靠的周界监控

## FAQ
Q: 安装后能否改变摄像机的视角？
A: 可以，电动镜头允许通过录像机或软件界面远程改变视角和焦点，无需登高接触摄像机。

Q: WDR 在拍摄入口区域时如何工作？
A: WDR 120dB 技术补偿室外与室内之间的亮度差异，使阴影中和明亮背景下的物体都能同时清晰可见。

Q: 该摄像机兼容其他制造商的录像机吗？
A: 摄像机支持 ONVIF 协议，从而兼容大多数现代网络视频录像机。

en.name: Dahua IPC-HDW1431T1-A dome IP camera
en.shortDescription: 4 MP dome IP camera with PoE and motion detection technology. The camera belongs to the Entry series, which combines an aesthetic appearance, compact dimensions and high performance. It has a high level of protection against dust and moisture,
en.description:

The camera combines a compact size, a neat appearance and high performance — ideal for video surveillance systems in offices, retail outlets and small sites. The built-in motion detection function and high dust and moisture protection rating ensure reliability in daily operation.

## Advantages
- 4 MP resolution: a detailed image for clear identification of faces and objects
- PoE power: a single network cable carries both data and power, saving time and money on installation
- Motion detection: intelligent response to events reduces the volume of unnecessary recordings
- Compact dome housing: an unobtrusive design that fits into the interior of any room
- High dust and moisture protection rating: reliable operation even in challenging conditions
- Dahua Entry series: an optimal price-to-quality ratio for mass application

## Applications
- Office buildings and business centers: monitoring of work areas, corridors and entrance groups
- Retail outlets and supermarkets: surveillance of the sales floor and checkout area
- Educational and childcare institutions: safety monitoring at entrances
- Hotels and service facilities: unobtrusive surveillance in public areas
- Small manufacturing and warehouses: indoor monitoring of the area

## FAQ
Q: Is a separate power supply needed for this camera?
A: No, the camera is powered via PoE through a standard network cable — just connect it to a PoE switch or injector.

Q: Is the camera suitable for outdoor mounting?
A: The high dust and moisture protection rating allows the camera to be mounted outdoors — check the specific IP rating with SAT Solutions specialists when choosing the installation location.

Q: Can the camera be integrated into an existing video surveillance system?
A: Yes, the camera is compatible with Dahua NVRs and supports the ONVIF protocol for integration with third-party equipment.

- Hareket algılama: olaylara akıllı tepki, gereksiz kayıt hacmini azaltır
- Kompakt dome gövde: göze çarpmayan tasarım, her mekânın iç düzenine uyum sağlar
- Toz ve neme karşı yüksek koruma sınıfı: zorlu koşullarda bile güvenilir kullanım
- Dahua Entry serisi: kitlesel kullanım için optimum fiyat-kalite oranı

## Uygulama alanları
- Ofis binaları ve iş merkezleri: çalışma alanları, koridorlar ve giriş bölgelerinin kontrolü
- Satış noktaları ve süpermarketler: satış alanı ve kasa bölgesinin gözetimi
- Eğitim kurumları ve çocuk kurumları: girişlerde güvenlik izleme
- Oteller ve hizmet tesisleri: ortak alanlarda göze çarpmayan gözetim
- Küçük üretim tesisleri ve depolar: iç bölge kontrolü

## FAQ
Q: Bu kamera için ayrı bir güç kaynağı gerekli mi?
A: Hayır, kamera standart ağ kablosu üzerinden PoE ile beslenir — bir PoE switch'e veya enjektöre bağlamak yeterlidir.

A: Toz ve neme karşı yüksek koruma sınıfı, kameranın dışarıya monte edilmesine olanak tanır — kurulum yerini seçerken spesifik IP derecesini SAT Solutions uzmanlarından teyit edin.

Q: Kamera mevcut bir video gözetim sistemine entegre edilebilir mi?
A: Evet, kamera Dahua NVR ile uyumludur ve üçüncü taraf üreticilerin ekipmanlarıyla entegrasyon için ONVIF protokolünü destekler.

- Dahua Entry 系列：面向大众应用的优良性价比

- 办公楼和商务中心：监控工作区、走廊和入口群

uz.name: Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 gumbazli IP-kamera
uz.shortDescription: Tashqi gumbazli IP-videokamera Full-color 4 MP; 1/3” CMOS; 3.6 mm obyektiv; WDR(120 dB); sezuvchanlik 0.004 lk@F1.0; siqish: H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG; 2 oqim 4 MP@25 k/s gacha; 30 m gacha LED-yoritish; oʻrnatilgan mikrofon; himoya: IP6
uz.description:
Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 — kechayu kunduz rangli videokuzatuv uchun 4 MP aniqlik va 30 m gacha LED-yoritgich bilan jihozlangan Full-color koʻcha kupolli IP-kamerasi. 1/3" CMOS matritsa va WDR 120 dB keng dinamik diapazoni har qanday yorugʻlikda aniq tasvirni kafolatlaydi, oʻrnatilgan mikrofon esa ovoz yozishni yuritish imkonini beradi. IP67 himoya darajasi har qanday ob-havo sharoitida ishonchli ishni taʼminlaydi.

## Afzalliklari
- Full-color suratga olish: LED-yoritgich tufayli tunda rangli tasvir — infraqizil kameralarga yaroqsiz detallar koʻrinadi
- 4 MP aniqlik: ishonchli aniqlash uchun yuqori detallashtirish
- WDR 120 dB: kadrda yorqinlikning keskin oʻzgarishida muvozanatli tasvir
- H.265+ kodeki: yozuv sifatini yoʻqotmasdan ixcham videooqim
- Oʻrnatilgan mikrofon: qoʻshimcha jihozsiz video va audioni bir vaqtda yozish
- IP67: tashqi montaj uchun changdan va suvdan ishonchli himoya

## Qoʻllanish sohalari
- Kirish guruhlari va peshtoq fasadlar: tashrif buyuruvchilarni tanish uchun rangli tungi suratga olish
- Avtoturargohlar va hovli hududlari: qorongʻida avtomobillar rangini koʻrish imkoniyati bilan monitoring
- Savdo obyektlari va bozorlar: tungi vaqtda bino tashqarisida kuzatuv
- Sanoat korxonalari: yetarli yoritilmaganda perimetrni qoʻriqlash
- Xususiy uy hovlilari: darvoza va toʻsiq yonida videokuzatuv

Q: Toʻliq rangli kamera oddiy infraqizil kameradan nimasi bilan yaxshiroq?

Q: Oʻrnatilgan mikrofon qanday ulanadi?

Q: Kamera xotira kartasiga yozishni qoʻllab-quvvatlaydimi?
A: microSD slotining mavjudligini SAT Solutions menejerlaridan aniqlab oling — ular yozuvlarni saqlashning optimal usulini tanlashga yordam beradi.

en.name: Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 dome IP camera
en.shortDescription: Outdoor dome IP camera Full-color 4 MP; 1/3” CMOS; 3.6 mm lens; WDR(120 dB); sensitivity 0.004 lx@F1.0; compression: H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG; 2 streams up to 4 MP@25 fps; LED illumination up to 30 m; built-in microphone; protection: IP6
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 is an outdoor full-color dome IP camera with 4 MP resolution and LED illumination up to 30 m for round-the-clock color video surveillance. The 1/3" CMOS sensor and a wide dynamic range of WDR 120 dB guarantee a clear image in any lighting, and the built-in microphone allows audio recording. The IP67 protection rating ensures reliable operation in any weather conditions.

## Advantages
- Full-color capture: a color image at night thanks to LED illumination — details are visible that are inaccessible to IR cameras
- 4 MP resolution: high detail for confident identification
- WDR 120 dB: a balanced image under sharp brightness differences in the frame
- H.265+ codec: a compact video stream without loss of recording quality
- Built-in microphone: simultaneous video and audio recording without additional equipment
- IP67: reliable protection from dust and water for outdoor mounting

## Applications
- Entrance groups and front facades: color night capture for identifying visitors
- Parking lots and courtyard areas: monitoring with the ability to see the color of vehicles in the dark
- Retail facilities and markets: surveillance outside the building at night
- Industrial enterprises: perimeter security in insufficient lighting
- Private residences: video surveillance at gates and fencing

## FAQ
Q: How is a full-color camera better than a regular IR camera?
A: Unlike IR illumination, LED lighting gives a color picture at night, allowing the color of clothing, vehicles and other objects to be distinguished — this significantly eases identification.

Q: How is the built-in microphone connected?
A: The microphone is built into the camera housing and works automatically — the audio stream is transmitted together with the video to a compatible NVR or platform.

Q: Does the camera support recording to a memory card?
A: Check for a microSD slot with SAT Solutions managers — they will help you choose the optimal way to store recordings.

tr.name: Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 dome IP kamera
tr.shortDescription: Dış mekan dome IP kamera Full-color 4 MP; 1/3” CMOS; 3.6 mm lens; WDR(120 dB); duyarlılık 0.004 lx@F1.0; sıkıştırma: H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG; 4 MP@25 fps'ye kadar 2 akış; 30 m'ye kadar LED aydınlatma; dahili mikrofon; koruma: IP6
tr.description:
Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 — yedi gün yirmi dört saat renkli video gözetimi için 4 MP çözünürlük ve 30 m'ye kadar LED aydınlatmaya sahip dış mekân Full-color dome IP kamera. 1/3" CMOS sensör ve geniş dinamik aralık WDR 120 dB her türlü aydınlatmada net görüntü garanti eder; dahili mikrofon ise ses kaydı yapmaya olanak tanır. IP67 koruma sınıfı her türlü hava koşulunda güvenilir çalışma sağlar.

## Avantajları
- Full-color çekim: LED aydınlatma sayesinde gece renkli görüntü — kızılötesi kameralara erişilemeyen detaylar görünür
- 4 MP çözünürlük: güvenli tanımlama için yüksek detay
- WDR 120 dB: karedeki keskin parlaklık farkında dengeli görüntü
- H.265+ kodek: kayıt kalitesinden ödün vermeden kompakt video akışı
- Dahili mikrofon: ek ekipman olmadan eşzamanlı video ve ses kaydı
- IP67: dış mekân montajı için toza ve suya karşı güvenilir koruma

## Uygulama alanları
- Girişler ve ana cepheler: ziyaretçilerin tanınması için renkli gece çekimi
- Otoparklar ve avlu alanları: karanlıkta araç rengini görme imkânıyla izleme
- Ticari tesisler ve pazarlar: gece saatlerinde bina dışı gözetim
- Endüstriyel tesisler: yetersiz aydınlatmada çevre güvenliği
- Özel konutlar: kapı ve çitte video gözetim

## FAQ
Q: Tam renkli kamera, sıradan kızılötesi kameradan neden daha iyidir?
A: Kızılötesi aydınlatmanın aksine LED aydınlatma gece renkli görüntü verir, bu da kıyafet, araç ve diğer nesnelerin rengini ayırt etmeye olanak tanır — bu, tanımlamayı önemli ölçüde kolaylaştırır.

Q: Dahili mikrofon nasıl bağlanır?
A: Mikrofon kamera gövdesine entegredir ve otomatik çalışır — ses akışı videoyla birlikte uyumlu bir NVR'ye veya platforma aktarılır.

Q: Kamera hafıza kartına kayıt yapmayı destekliyor mu?
A: microSD yuvasının bulunup bulunmadığını SAT Solutions yöneticilerinden teyit edin — kayıtların saklanması için en uygun yöntemi belirlemenize yardımcı olurlar.

zh.name: Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4 半球型 IP 摄像机
zh.shortDescription: 室外半球型 IP 摄像机 Full-color 4 MP；1/3” CMOS；3.6 mm 镜头；WDR(120 dB)；灵敏度 0.004 lx@F1.0；压缩：H.265+、H.265、H.264+、H.264、MJPEG；最高 4 MP@25 fps 双码流；LED 补光距离达 30 m；内置麦克风；防护：IP6

Dahua IPC-HDW1439T-A-LED-S4——是一款室外半球形 Full-color IP 摄像机，分辨率 4 MP，LED 补光高达 30 m，用于全天候彩色视频监控。1/3" CMOS 传感器和 120 dB 宽动态范围 WDR 保证在任何照明下都有清晰图像，内置麦克风可进行声音录制。IP67 防护等级确保在任何天气条件下可靠工作。

## 优势
- Full-color 拍摄：凭借 LED 补光在夜间获得彩色图像——可见红外摄像机无法捕捉的细节
- 4 MP 分辨率：高细节度用于可靠识别
- WDR 120 dB：画面中亮度剧烈变化时图像均衡
- H.265+ 编解码器：紧凑的视频流而不损失录制质量
- 内置麦克风：无需额外设备即可同时录制视频和音频
- IP67：可靠防尘防水，适合室外安装

## 应用领域
- 入口区和正门立面：彩色夜间拍摄以辨认访客
- 停车场和庭院区域：可在黑暗中看到车辆颜色的监控
- 商业场所和市场：夜间对建筑外部的监控
- 工业企业：照明不足时的周界安防
- 私人住宅：大门和围栏处的视频监控

## FAQ
Q: 全彩摄像机相比普通红外摄像机好在哪里？
A: 与红外补光不同，LED 照明在夜间提供彩色画面，可分辨衣物、车辆及其他物体的颜色——这大大便于识别。

Q: 内置麦克风如何连接？
A: 麦克风内置于摄像机外壳并自动工作——音频流与视频一起传输到兼容的 NVR 或平台。

Q: 该摄像机支持录制到存储卡吗？
A: 请向 SAT Solutions 经理咨询是否有 microSD 插槽——他们将帮助您选择最佳的录像存储方式。

- SMD 4.0 with AI: next-generation intelligent detection for precise classification of objects in the frame

- 4 MP resolution with WDR 120 dB: high detail in challenging lighting
- H.265+ codec: three video streams with maximum storage efficiency
- 2.8 mm lens: a wide field of view to cover large zones
- IP67: reliable protection for outdoor operation in any climatic conditions

Q: How does SMD 4.0 differ from ordinary motion detection?
A: SMD 4.0 uses deep-learning algorithms for precise separation of people, vehicles and extraneous objects, which significantly reduces the percentage of false alarms compared to classic motion detection.

Q: How many video streams does the camera support simultaneously?
A: The camera supports three independent video streams, allowing flexible quality configuration for recording, remote viewing and mobile access.

Q: At what distance does the IR illumination provide a clear image?

en.name: Dahua IPC-HDW3849H-AS-PV dome IP camera
en.shortDescription: 8-megapixel WizSense intelligent network camera with dual illumination and active deterrence, fixed focal length. * The parameters and specifications below apply only to the 3849-PV-S5 series. > 8
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HDW3849H-AS-PV is an 8-megapixel dome IP camera of the WizSense series with dual illumination and an active deterrence function. The device is designed for sites where not only event recording but also instant response to intruders is required: the camera is able to scare off an intruder with light and sound without operator involvement. The IP67 protection rating and H.265 compression make it a reliable choice for round-the-clock security outdoors and indoors.

## Advantages
- 8 MP resolution — a detailed image allows identification of faces and vehicle plates even when zooming in on the recording
- Dual illumination — a combination of IR and white illumination provides a clear picture both in complete darkness and in mixed-lighting conditions
- Active deterrence — the camera responds to motion on its own: light and sound signals scare off intruders without security intervention
- H.265 compression — reduces network load and storage volume while preserving high video quality
- 1/2.7-inch sensor — provides good light sensitivity in low-light conditions
- IP67 protection rating — the camera is resistant to dust and water jets, suitable for outdoor installation in any climatic conditions

## Applications
- Perimeter security of private homes and cottage settlements — active deterrence reduces the number of actual break-ins
- Shopping centers and supermarkets — monitoring of entrance groups and parking lots with the ability to review incidents in detail
- Industrial enterprises and warehouses — surveillance of the territory at night without additional lighting
- Administrative buildings — video monitoring of restricted-access zones
- Car parks — recognition of license plates thanks to the high resolution

## FAQ
Q: Does the camera work without additional lighting?
A: Yes, the dual illumination allows a clear color or black-and-white image to be obtained even in a complete absence of external light.
Q: How do I connect the camera to power?
A: The camera is powered by a 12 V source; check with a SAT Solutions specialist for a suitable connection option for your site.
Q: Can the response to motion be configured manually?
A: The parameters of the detection zones and the type of response (light, sound or both signals) are configured through the web interface or Dahua software.

- 双重补光——红外与白光补光的结合在完全黑暗和混合照明条件下都能提供清晰画面
- 主动威慑——摄像机自主对运动作出反应：光声信号在无安保介入的情况下吓退入侵者
- H.265 压缩——在保持高视频质量的同时降低网络负荷和存储体积
- 1/2.7 英寸传感器——在弱照明条件下提供良好的感光度
- IP67 防护等级——摄像机耐尘耐水流，适合在任何气候条件下室外安装

## 应用领域
- 私人住宅和别墅区的周界安防——主动威慑减少实际入侵次数
- 购物中心和超市——监控入口区和停车场，并可详细分析事件
- 工业企业和仓库——夜间无需额外照明即可监控区域
- 行政楼宇——对限制访问区域进行视频监控
- 汽车停车场——凭借高分辨率识别车牌

## FAQ
Q: 该摄像机无需额外照明也能工作吗？
A: 可以，双重补光即使在完全没有外部光源的情况下也能获得清晰的彩色或黑白图像。
Q: 如何为摄像机接通电源？
A: 摄像机由 12 V 电源供电；请向 SAT Solutions 专家咨询适合您场所的连接方案。
Q: 可以自行设置对运动的反应吗？
A: 检测区域参数和反应类型（光、声或两种信号）可通过 Web 界面或 Dahua 软件进行设置。

U montajdan keyin koʻrish burchagini kameraga koʻtarilmasdan masofadan moslashtirish kerak boʻlgan obyektlar uchun moʻljallangan. 120 dB keng dinamik diapazoni va PoE orqali quvvatlash oʻrnatishni qulay qiladi, H.265+ esa arxivni tejamkor saqlashni taʼminlaydi.

en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW2841T-ZS dome IP camera
en.shortDescription: Outdoor dome IP camera 8 MP, 1/2.7” CMOS, ICR, WDR(120 dB), sensitivity 0.008 lx@F1.5; compression: H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264/H.264B/H.264H/MJPEG, 2 streams. Video resolution and frame rate 8 MP (1~20 fps), with a motorized lens
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW2841T-ZS is an outdoor dome IP camera with 8 MP resolution and a motorized varifocal lens. It is designed for sites where the viewing angle needs to be adjusted remotely after installation, without climbing up to the camera. A wide dynamic range of 120 dB and PoE power make installation convenient, while H.265+ ensures economical archive storage.

## Advantages
- 8 MP resolution — high frame detail for subsequent identification of people and vehicles
- Motorized lens — angle and focus are adjusted remotely via software without physical access to the camera
- WDR 120 dB — the camera simultaneously renders dark and bright areas of the frame well, for example a building entrance against backlight
- H.265+ compression — maximizes disk space and network bandwidth savings without loss of quality
- PoE power — a single cable carries both data and power, which simplifies installation and reduces its cost
- IP67 protection rating — full dust protection and protection against water jets for reliable outdoor operation

## Applications
- Shopping and business centers — monitoring entrances, lobbies and inner courtyards with the ability to change the viewing angle without dismounting
- Parking lots and open areas — long-range surveillance with license plate detail
- Perimeter security of enterprises — flexible adjustment of the surveillance zone after installation
- Educational institutions — monitoring areas with changing layouts
- Construction sites — monitoring of a changing work zone

## FAQ
Q: Can the camera's viewing angle be changed after installation?
A: Yes, the motorized lens allows zoom and focus to be adjusted via software without climbing up to the camera.
Q: How do I connect the camera without an additional power source?
A: The camera supports PoE power — a single network cable from a PoE-enabled switch is enough.
Q: How well does the camera perform in bright backlight?
A: The wide dynamic range of 120 dB allows the camera to correctly render details in both dark and brightly lit areas of a single frame.

tr.name: Dahua IPC-HFW2841T-ZS dome IP kamera
tr.shortDescription: Dış mekan dome IP kamera 8 MP, 1/2.7” CMOS, ICR, WDR(120 dB), duyarlılık 0.008 lx@F1.5; sıkıştırma: H.265+/H.265/H.264+/H.264/H.264B/H.264H/MJPEG, 2 akış. Video çözünürlüğü ve akış hızı 8 MP (1~20 fps), motorlu lens ile
tr.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW2841T-ZS — 8 MP çözünürlüğe ve motorlu varifokal lense sahip dış mekan dome IP kamera. Montajdan sonra kameraya çıkmadan, görüş açısının uzaktan ayarlanması gereken tesisler için tasarlanmıştır. 120 dB geniş dinamik aralık ve PoE ile besleme kurulumu kolaylaştırır, H.265+ ise arşivin ekonomik şekilde saklanmasını sağlar.

## Avantajları
- 8 MP çözünürlük — insanların ve araçların sonradan tanımlanması için yüksek kare detayı
- Motorlu lens — açı ve odak, kameraya fiziksel erişim olmadan yazılım üzerinden uzaktan ayarlanır
- WDR 120 dB — kamera karenin hem karanlık hem de aydınlık bölgelerini aynı anda iyi gösterir, örneğin ışığa karşı binanın girişini
- H.265+ sıkıştırma — kalite kaybı olmadan disk alanını ve ağ trafiğini en üst düzeyde tasarruf eder
- PoE ile besleme — tek kablo hem veriyi hem de gücü taşır, bu da montajı kolaylaştırır ve maliyetini düşürür
- IP67 koruma sınıfı — dış mekanda güvenilir çalışma için tam toz koruması ve su jetlerine karşı koruma

## Uygulama alanları
- Alışveriş ve iş merkezleri — girişlerin, lobilerin ve iç avluların, sökmeden görüş açısını değiştirme imkanıyla kontrolü
- Otoparklar ve açık alanlar — plakaların detaylandırılmasıyla uzun mesafede gözetim
- İşletmelerin çevre güvenliği — kurulumdan sonra gözetim bölgesinin esnek ayarı
- Eğitim kurumları — değişen yerleşim planına sahip alanların izlenmesi
- İnşaat tesisleri — değişen çalışma bölgesinin gözetimi

## FAQ
Q: Kameranın görüş açısı montajdan sonra değiştirilebilir mi?
A: Evet, motorlu lens zoom ve odağın kameraya çıkmadan yazılım üzerinden ayarlanmasına olanak tanır.
Q: Kamera ek bir güç kaynağı olmadan nasıl bağlanır?
A: Kamera PoE ile beslemeyi destekler — PoE destekli bir switch'ten gelen tek bir ağ kablosu yeterlidir.
Q: Kamera parlak karşı ışıkta ne kadar iyi çalışır?
A: 120 dB geniş dinamik aralık, kameranın aynı karenin hem karanlık hem de parlak aydınlatılmış bölgelerindeki detayları doğru şekilde göstermesini sağlar.

## 优势
- 8 MP 分辨率——画面细节丰富，便于后续识别人员和车辆
- 电动镜头——通过软件远程调节视角和焦距，无需实际接触摄像机
- WDR 120 dB——摄像机可同时清晰呈现画面的明暗区域，例如逆光下的建筑入口
- H.265+ 压缩——在不损失画质的前提下最大限度节省磁盘空间和网络流量
- PoE 供电——一根线缆同时传输数据和电力，简化安装并降低成本

## FAQ
Q: 安装后能否改变摄像机的视角？

Q: 如何在没有额外供电源的情况下接入摄像机？
A: 该摄像机支持 PoE 供电——只需从支持 PoE 的交换机引一根网线即可。
Q: 摄像机在强烈逆光下表现如何？
A: 120 dB 宽动态范围使摄像机能在同一画面的明暗区域中都正确呈现细节。

uz.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW silindrik IP-kamera

- 2 MP Full HD oʻlcham — kirish zonalari, koridorlar va kichik hududlarni ishonchli nazorat qilish uchun yetarli
- Oʻrnatilgan Wi-Fi — simsiz ulanish har bir kuzatuv nuqtasiga tarmoq kabelini tortish zaruratini yoʻqotadi

en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW bullet IP camera
en.shortDescription: > 2-megapixel 1/3-inch CMOS sensor providing low light and high-resolution image. > Output max. 2 MP (1920 × 1080) at 25/30 fps. > H.265 codec, high compression ratio, ultra-low bit rate
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW is a compact bullet IP camera with 2 MP resolution and a built-in Wi-Fi adapter. The model is aimed at small sites where running a network cable is difficult or undesirable: wireless connection simplifies installation and reduces its cost. The H.265 codec and IP67 protection ensure economical operation in any weather conditions.

## Advantages
- 2 MP Full HD resolution — sufficient for reliable monitoring of entrance areas, corridors and small territories
- Built-in Wi-Fi — wireless connection eliminates the need to run a network cable to each surveillance point
- 1/3 inch CMOS sensor — provides a clear image in low light
- H.265 compression — reduces archive file size and lowers the load on the data transmission channel
- IP67 protection rating — the camera is protected against dust and precipitation, suitable for outdoor installation
- Built-in IR illumination — enables surveillance at night without external light sources

## Applications
- Shops and cafes — quick installation without renovation work to run cables
- Offices and administrative premises — unobtrusive monitoring of work areas with a wireless connection
- Private houses and country homes — perimeter security where cable routing is inconvenient
- Small warehouses and production facilities — an economical solution for basic video surveillance
- Temporary sites — quick deployment without permanent installation

## FAQ
Q: Is a cable needed to connect the camera?
A: The camera connects via Wi-Fi, however a 12 V power cable will need to be run or a compatible PoE adapter used.
Q: What is the range of the wireless connection?
A: The range depends on the surrounding environment and the router used; for stable operation it is recommended to place the camera in an area with a strong signal.
Q: Is the camera suitable for outdoor use?
A: Yes, the IP67 protection rating allows the camera to be operated outdoors in any weather.

tr.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW bullet IP kamera
tr.shortDescription: > Düşük ışık ve yüksek çözünürlüklü görüntü sağlayan 2 megapiksel 1/3 inç CMOS sensör. > Maks. 2 MP (1920 × 1080) @ 25/30 fps çıkış. > H.265 codec, yüksek sıkıştırma oranı, ultra düşük bit hızı

- 2 MP Full HD çözünürlük — giriş bölgelerinin, koridorların ve küçük alanların güvenilir kontrolü için yeterli
- Dahili Wi-Fi — kablosuz bağlantı, her gözetim noktasına ağ kablosu döşeme gerekliliğini ortadan kaldırır
- 1/3 inç CMOS sensör — düşük aydınlatmada net görüntü sağlar

- Özel evler ve yazlıklar — kablo tesisatının kullanışsız olduğu yerlerde çevre güvenliği

- Geçici tesisler — büyük çaplı montaj olmadan hızlı kurulum

en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230DS1-SAW bullet IP camera
en.shortDescription: · 2-megapixel 1/2.8-inch CMOS sensor, low light and high-definition image. · Outputs max. 2 MP (1920 × 1080) at 25/30 fps. · H.265 codec, high compression ratio, ultra-low bit rate. ·
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW1230DS1-SAW is a bullet IP camera with 2 MP resolution and a built-in wireless module. The device is created for sites where video surveillance needs to be set up quickly without running network cables. A 1/2 inch CMOS sensor, the H.265 codec and IP67 protection ensure high-quality imaging and durability in outdoor operation.

## Advantages
- 1/2 inch sensor — a larger sensor captures more light, providing a better image in low-light conditions compared to smaller sensors
- 2 MP Full HD resolution — a clear 1920×1080 frame for reliable identification of people and vehicles
- Built-in Wi-Fi — allows the camera to be placed without running a network cable
- H.265 codec — efficient compression reduces the load on storage and the network
- IP67 protection rating — full protection against dust and water jets for outdoor operation
- Compact form factor — easy installation on a wall or ceiling without special mounting

## Applications
- Retail outlets and restaurants — wireless installation without renovation
- Private residences — security of entrances and driveways
- Office spaces — monitoring of meeting rooms and work areas
- Small business warehouses — basic video surveillance with minimal investment
- Temporary construction sites — rapid deployment and dismantling

## FAQ
Q: How does this model differ from the IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW?
A: The DS1-SAW model is equipped with a 1/2 inch sensor instead of 1/3, which provides better light sensitivity with otherwise similar specifications.
Q: Does the camera require wired power when connected wirelessly?
A: Yes, Wi-Fi removes the need for a network cable, but 12 V power still needs to be run to the camera.
Q: Can the camera be used in the northern regions of Uzbekistan, where it gets frosty in winter?
A: Check the operating temperature range with SAT Solutions specialists; the IP67 rating protects against moisture, however the operating temperature range depends on the specific model.

- 2 MP Full HD çözünürlük — insanların ve araçların güvenilir tanımlanması için net 1920×1080 kare
- Dahili Wi-Fi — kameranın ağ kablosu döşemeden yerleştirilmesine olanak tanır
- H.265 codec'i — verimli sıkıştırma depolama ve ağ üzerindeki yükü azaltır
- IP67 koruma sınıfı — dış mekan kullanımı için toza ve su jetlerine karşı tam koruma
- Kompakt form faktörü — özel bir bağlantı parçası olmadan duvara veya tavana kolay montaj

## Uygulama alanları
- Satış noktaları ve restoranlar — tadilat olmadan kablosuz montaj
- Özel konutlar — girişlerin ve giriş yollarının güvenliği
- Ofis alanları — toplantı ve çalışma bölgelerinin kontrolü
- Küçük işletme depoları — minimum yatırımla temel video gözetim
- Geçici inşaat tesisleri — operatif kurulum ve sökme

## FAQ
Q: Bu model IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW'dan ne ile farklılaşıyor?
A: DS1-SAW modeli 1/3 yerine 1/2 inç sensörle donatılmıştır, bu da benzer diğer özelliklerle birlikte daha iyi ışık hassasiyeti sağlar.
Q: Kablosuz bağlantıda kamera kablolu besleme gerektirir mi?
A: Evet, Wi-Fi ağ kablosu gerekliliğini ortadan kaldırır, ancak 12 V besleme yine de kameraya getirilmelidir.
Q: Kamera, kışın don olan Özbekistan'ın kuzey bölgelerinde kullanılabilir mi?

zh.description:

## 优势
- 1/2 英寸传感器——更大的感光元件能捕捉更多光线，相较更小的传感器在弱光条件下提供更优画面
- 2 MP Full HD 分辨率——1920×1080 清晰画面，可靠识别人员和车辆
- 内置 Wi-Fi——无需敷设网络电缆即可安放摄像机
- H.265 编码——高效压缩，降低存储和网络负载
- IP67 防护等级——全面防尘防水流，适合户外使用
- 紧凑外形——可轻松安装于墙面或天花板，无需专用支架

## 应用领域
- 零售店和餐厅——无需装修即可无线安装
- 私人住宅——保护出入口和车辆通道
- 办公空间——监控会议室和工作区
- 小型企业仓库——以最少投入实现基础视频监控
- 临时建筑工地——快速部署与拆除

## FAQ
Q: 该型号与 IPC-HFW1230DS-SAW 有何区别？
A: DS1-SAW 型号采用 1/2 英寸传感器而非 1/3 英寸，在其他参数相近的情况下提供更好的感光性能。
Q: 无线连接时摄像机仍需有线供电吗？
A: 是的，Wi-Fi 免去了网络电缆的需求，但仍需为摄像机接入 12 V 供电。
Q: 该摄像机可用于乌兹别克斯坦北部冬季有严寒的地区吗？
A: 请向 SAT Solutions 专家确认工作温度范围；IP67 等级可防潮，但工作温度范围取决于具体型号。

- 2.8–12 mm motorlashtirilgan obyektiv — fokus masofalarining keng diapazoni optikani almashtirmasdan keng zonani ham, uzoq planni ham qamrab olish imkonini beradi

- Binolar va xususiy uylarning tashqi perimetri — qoʻshimcha yoritishsiz 40 m gacha masofada himoya

- Maktab va sport obyektlari — IK10 himoyalangan korpus tasodifiy zarbalarga bardosh beradi

Q: Kamera uni teginishlari mumkin boʻlgan joylarga montaj qilish uchun mosmi?

en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230S1 bullet IP camera
en.shortDescription: 2 MP; 1/2.8” CMOS; motorized lens 2.8~12 mm; mechanical IR filter; sensitivity 0.008 lx@F1.7; compression: H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG; 2 streams up to 2 MP@25 fps; IR illumination up to 40 m; MicroSD up to 256 GB; protection: IP67, IK10; p
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW1230S1 is a 2 MP bullet IP camera with a 2.8–12 mm motorized varifocal lens and IR illumination up to 40 meters. This is a solution for those who value flexibility in adjusting the viewing angle and reliable operation at night. IP67 and IK10 protection, support for MicroSD cards up to 256 GB, and H.265+ compression make the camera a versatile choice for security both outdoors and indoors.

## Advantages
- 2.8–12 mm motorized lens — a wide range of focal lengths covers both a broad zone and a distant view without changing optics
- IR illumination up to 40 m — confident night surveillance at a considerable distance
- IK10 protection — the housing is resistant to mechanical impacts, which is important for cameras in public places
- Local MicroSD storage up to 256 GB — a standalone archive even if connection to the server is lost
- H.265+ compression — minimizes occupied space at high video quality
- IP67 rating — reliable operation in rain, dusty conditions and temperature fluctuations

## Applications
- Outer perimeter of buildings and private houses — security at distances up to 40 m without additional lighting
- Parking lots and entry groups — vehicle monitoring with a variable viewing angle
- School and sports facilities — the protected IK10 housing withstands accidental impacts
- Small warehouses and production facilities — standalone recording to a memory card when the internet is unreliable
- Shopping streets and markets — wide-angle or telephoto positions for different scenarios

## FAQ
Q: Why is a motorized lens needed if the camera can simply be turned?
A: Motorized zoom changes the viewing angle and focal length remotely via software, requiring no physical access to the device after installation.
Q: What happens to the recording if the internet or the DVR power fails?
A: With a MicroSD card installed, the camera continues to record video locally, and the archive is saved to the card until the connection is restored.
Q: Is the camera suitable for installation in places where it could be bumped?
A: Yes, the vandal-proof housing with IK10 protection withstands mechanical impacts, which makes the camera suitable for public places.

tr.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230S1 bullet IP kamera

IP67 ve IK10 koruması, 256 GB'a kadar MicroSD kart desteği ve H.265+ sıkıştırma, kamerayı dış ve iç mekan güvenliği için çok yönlü bir seçim haline getirir.

- 2.8–12 mm motorlu lens — geniş odak uzaklığı aralığı, optiği değiştirmeden hem geniş bölgeyi hem de uzak planı kapsamaya olanak tanır
- 40 m'ye kadar IR aydınlatma — önemli bir mesafede güvenli gece gözetimi
- IK10 koruması — gövde mekanik darbelere dayanıklıdır, bu da halka açık yerlerdeki kameralar için önemlidir
- 256 GB'a kadar MicroSD yerel depolama — sunucuyla bağlantı kesilse bile özerk arşiv
- H.265+ sıkıştırma — yüksek video kalitesinde kaplanan alanı en aza indirir
- IP67 sınıfı — yağmur altında, tozlu koşullarda ve sıcaklık değişimlerinde güvenilir çalışma

## Uygulama alanları
- Binaların ve özel evlerin dış çevresi — ek aydınlatma olmadan 40 m'ye kadar mesafede güvenlik
- Otoparklar ve giriş grupları — değişken görüş açısıyla araç kontrolü
- Okul ve spor tesisleri — IK10 korumalı gövde rastgele darbelere dayanır
- Küçük depolar ve üretim tesisleri — güvenilmez internette hafıza kartına özerk kayıt
- Ticaret caddeleri ve pazarlar — farklı senaryolar için geniş açı veya tele konumu

Q: Kamerayı sadece çevirmek mümkünken motorlu lens neden gereklidir?
A: Motorlu zoom görüş açısını ve odak uzaklığını yazılım üzerinden uzaktan değiştirir, montajdan sonra cihaza fiziksel erişim gerektirmez.
Q: İnternet kesilirse veya video kaydedicinin beslemesi giderse kayda ne olur?
A: Takılı MicroSD kart varsa kamera videoyu yerel olarak kaydetmeye devam eder, bağlantı yeniden kurulana kadar arşiv kartta saklanır.
Q: Kamera, çarpılabileceği yerlere montaj için uygun mu?
A: Evet, IK10 korumalı vandalizme dayanıklı gövde mekanik darbelere dayanır, bu da kamerayı halka açık yerler için uygun hale getirir.

zh.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1230S1 筒型 IP 摄像机

## 优势
- 2.8–12 mm 电动镜头——宽广的焦距范围既能覆盖大面积区域，也能拍摄远景，无需更换光学元件
- 红外补光最远 40 m——在较远距离实现稳定的夜间监控
- IK10 防护——机身耐机械冲击，这对公共场所的摄像机很重要
- MicroSD 本地存储最高 256 GB——即使与服务器失联也能自主归档
- H.265+ 压缩——在高画质下最大限度减少占用空间
- IP67 等级——在雨中、多尘环境和温差条件下可靠运行

## 应用领域
- 建筑和私人住宅外部周界——最远 40 m 无需额外照明即可守护
- 停车场和入口区域——以可变视角监控车辆
- 学校和体育场所——IK10 防护机身可承受意外冲击
- 小型仓库和生产场所——互联网不稳定时本地存储卡录像
- 商业街和市场——广角或长焦位置适应不同场景

## FAQ
Q: 既然可以直接转动摄像机，为什么还需要电动镜头？
A: 电动变焦可通过软件远程改变视角和焦距，安装后无需物理接触设备。
Q: 如果互联网中断或录像机断电，录像会怎样？
A: 装有 MicroSD 卡时，摄像机会继续在本地录像，归档保存在卡上直至恢复连接。
Q: 摄像机适合安装在可能被碰到的地方吗？
A: 适合，具备 IK10 防护的防破坏机身可承受机械冲击，使摄像机适用于公共场所。

A: The built-in white illumination provides a color image at a distance of up to 10 meters.
Q: Can the camera be used without PoE, from an ordinary power supply?

- Renkli gece çekimi — LED aydınlatma karanlıkta IR'deki gibi siyah-beyaz değil, tam renkli görüntü oluşturur
- PoE ile besleme — tek ağ kablosu ayrı bir güç kablosunun yerini alır, montaj maliyetlerini düşürür
- 2 MP Full HD çözünürlük — giriş gruplarının ve küçük alanların kontrolü için yeterli detay
- 1/2.8 inç sensör — yetersiz aydınlatma koşullarında iyi ışık hassasiyeti
- H.265+ sıkıştırma — arşiv disk alanından ve internet kanalından tasarruf
- IP67 koruma sınıfı — yağmur, kar ve tozda elektroniğe zarar vermeden çalışma

## Uygulama alanları
- Apartman girişleri ve giriş grupları — ziyaretçilerin gece renkli tanımlanması
- Küçük mağazalar ve eczaneler — ek güç kaynakları olmadan PoE ile ekonomik montaj
- Ofis binaları — koridorların ve resepsiyon bölgelerinin kontrolü
- Özel konutlar — basit bağlantıyla dış mekan video gözetimi
- Sağlık kurumları — girişlerin ve çevre alanın diskret kontrolü

## FAQ
Q: PoE ile beslemeli kamera nasıl bağlanır?

A: Evet, kamera 12 V doğru akım beslemeyi destekler — bu, PoE switch'i olmayan yerlerde kullanışlıdır.

zh.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1239S1-LED-S5 筒型 IP 摄像机
zh.shortDescription: 室外筒型 IP 摄像机 Full-color 2 MP；1/2.8” CMOS；2.8 mm 镜头；灵敏度 0.005 lx@F1.6；压缩：H.265+、H.265、H.264+、H.264、MJPEG；最高 2 MP@25 fps 双码流；LED 补光距离达 10 m；防护：IP67；供电：12 V(DC)、PoE；

## 优势
- 彩色夜间拍摄——LED 补光在黑暗中形成全彩画面，而非红外那样的黑白
- PoE 供电——一根网线取代单独的电源线，降低安装成本
- 2 MP Full HD 分辨率——对监控入口区和小型区域有足够的细节度
- 1/2.8 英寸传感器——在照明不足条件下有良好的感光度
- H.265+ 压缩——节省归档磁盘空间和互联网带宽
- IP67 防护等级——在雨、雪和灰尘中工作而不损坏电子元件

## 应用领域
- 门厅和入口区——夜间彩色识别访客
- 小型商店和药店——采用 PoE 的经济安装，无需额外电源
- 办公楼宇——监控走廊和前台区域
- 私人住宅——简单连接的室外视频监控

## FAQ
Q: 如何连接 PoE 供电的摄像机？

Q: LED 补光的工作距离是多少？
A: 内置白光补光在最远 10 米的距离提供彩色图像。
Q: 可以不用 PoE，而用普通电源供电吗？
A: 可以，摄像机支持 12 V 直流供电——在没有 PoE 交换机的地方很方便。

Oʻrnatilgan mikrofon tovushni qayd etadi, 3.6 mm obyektiv esa kirish zonalari va kichik xonalarni kuzatish uchun qulay keng koʻrish burchagini taʼminlaydi. - 3.6 mm obyektiv — keng koʻrish burchagi kirish zonasi yoki kichik xonani toʻliq qamrab oladi
- 1/2.8 dyuymli matritsa — zaif yoritilganlikda yaxshi yorugʻlikka sezuvchanlik
- H.265+ siqish — yuqori video sifatida disk maydonidan samarali foydalanish
- IP67 himoya darajasi — atmosfera yogʻinlari va changga chidamlilik

- Turar-joy uylari va ofislarning kirish guruhlari — keng 3.6 mm burchak eshik oldidagi maydonni qamrab oladi

A: 3.6 mm obyektiv yaqin nazorat uchun optimal keng koʻrish burchagini beradi. Uzoq zonalar uchun uzunroq fokus masofali kameralar tavsiya etiladi.

en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1239TL1-A-IL bullet IP camera
en.shortDescription: Professional 2 MP bullet IP camera built on a 1/2.8" CMOS sensor. Resolution 1920×1080 - 25 fps. Compression format H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG. Lens 3.6 mm; dual illumination: IR illumination 30 m, LED illumination 30 m.
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW1239TL1-A-IL is a 2 MP bullet IP camera with dual illumination: IR at 30 m and white LED at 30 m. A built-in microphone captures sound, while the 3.6 mm lens provides a wide viewing angle convenient for monitoring entrance areas and small rooms. Dual illumination allows choosing the operating mode: a color image with LED or long-range surveillance in IR.

## Advantages
- Dual illumination — IR 30 m and white LED 30 m — the camera adapts to any lighting conditions: color night recording or long-range black-and-white surveillance
- Built-in microphone — synchronous audio recording without additional equipment
- 3.6 mm lens — a wide viewing angle covers the entrance area or a small room entirely
- 1/2.8 inch sensor — good light sensitivity in low light
- H.265+ compression — efficient use of disk space at high video quality
- IP67 protection rating — resistance to precipitation and dust

## Applications
- Entrance groups of residential buildings and offices — the wide 3.6 mm angle covers the area in front of the door
- Shops and retail pavilions — audiovisual recording for resolving disputed situations
- Banks and communication offices — monitoring of customer areas with sound recording
- Private residences — night recording in color or IR, your choice
- Medical institutions — discreet surveillance with audio recording in corridors and registries

## FAQ
Q: How do I switch between IR and LED illumination?
A: The illumination mode is configured in the camera's web interface or via Dahua software — you can set a schedule or automatic switching.
Q: Is sound recorded only during motion or continuously?
A: The audio recording mode is configurable: continuous recording or event-based recording — depending on the system configuration.
Q: Is the 3.6 mm lens suitable for long-range surveillance?
A: The 3.6 mm lens provides a wide viewing angle, optimal for close-range monitoring. For distant zones, cameras with a longer focal length are recommended.

tr.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1239TL1-A-IL bullet IP kamera
tr.shortDescription: 1/2.8" CMOS matris üzerine kurulu profesyonel 2 MP bullet IP kamera. Çözünürlük 1920×1080 - 25 fps. Sıkıştırma formatı H.265+, H.265, H.264+, H.264, MJPEG. Lens 3.6 mm; çift aydınlatma: IR aydınlatma 30 m, LED aydınlatma 30 m.

Dahili mikrofon sesi kaydeder, 3.6 mm lens ise giriş bölgelerinin ve küçük mekanların gözetimi için uygun geniş bir görüş açısı sağlar. Çift aydınlatma çalışma modunu seçmeye olanak tanır: LED ile renkli görüntü veya IR ile uzak gözetim.

## Avantajları
- Çift aydınlatma — 30 m IR ve 30 m beyaz LED — kamera her türlü aydınlatma koşuluna uyum sağlar: renkli gece çekimi veya uzak siyah-beyaz gözetim
- Dahili mikrofon — ek ekipman olmadan senkronize ses kaydı
- 3.6 mm lens — geniş görüş açısı giriş bölgesini veya küçük bir mekanı tamamen kapsar
- 1/2.8 inç sensör — zayıf aydınlatmada iyi ışık hassasiyeti
- H.265+ sıkıştırma — yüksek video kalitesinde disk alanının verimli kullanımı
- IP67 koruma sınıfı — atmosferik yağışlara ve toza karşı dayanıklılık

## Uygulama alanları
- Konut ve ofis binalarının giriş grupları — geniş 3.6 mm açı kapının önündeki alanı kapsar
- Mağazalar ve ticari pavyonlar — ihtilaflı durumların çözümü için sesli görüntülü kayıt
- Bankalar ve iletişim şubeleri — ses kaydıyla müşteri bölgelerinin kontrolü
- Özel konutlar — isteğe bağlı olarak renkli veya IR gece çekimi
- Sağlık kurumları — koridorlarda ve kayıt bölümlerinde ses kayıtlı diskret gözetim

## FAQ
Q: IR ve LED aydınlatma arasında nasıl geçiş yapılır?
A: Aydınlatma modu kameranın web arayüzünde veya Dahua yazılımı üzerinden ayarlanır — bir zamanlama veya otomatik geçiş tanımlanabilir.
Q: Ses yalnızca hareket sırasında mı yoksa sürekli mi kaydedilir?
A: Ses kaydı modu ayarlanabilir: sürekli kayıt veya olay üzerine kayıt — sistem yapılandırmasına bağlıdır.
Q: 3.6 mm lens uzun mesafe gözetimi için uygun mu?
A: 3.6 mm lens yakın kontrol için optimal geniş bir görüş açısı verir. Uzak bölgeler için daha uzun odak uzaklığına sahip kameralar önerilir.

zh.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1239TL1-A-IL 筒型 IP 摄像机

- H.265+ 压缩——在高画质的同时高效利用磁盘空间
- IP67 防护等级——抵御雨雪和灰尘

- 住宅和办公楼的入口区——3.6 mm 宽视角覆盖门前空间

A: 3.6 mm 镜头提供宽视角，最适合近距离监控。对于远距离区域，建议选用更长焦距的摄像机。

en.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1430DS-SAW bullet IP camera
en.shortDescription: > 4 MP, 1/3" CMOS sensor, high sensitivity, high resolution > Maximum video stream 4 MP (2560×1440) @ 20 fps, 3 MP (2304×1296) @ 25 fps > H.265 codec, high compression ratio, ultra-small video stream size > Built-in IR illumination
en.description:
Dahua IPC-HFW1430DS-SAW is a bullet IP camera with 4 MP resolution and a built-in Wi-Fi module. The high resolution of the 1/3 inch sensor provides a detailed frame, while wireless connection simplifies installation where running a network cable is impossible or impractical. The H.265 codec and IP67 protection guarantee economical and reliable outdoor operation.

## Advantages
- 4 MP resolution — twice as much detail compared to Full HD, which simplifies the identification of people and vehicles
- Built-in Wi-Fi — installation without running a network cable, quick installation at any site
- H.265 codec — high compression while preserving quality, archive space savings
- 1/3 inch CMOS sensor — high light sensitivity for a clear image in various lighting conditions
- Built-in IR illumination — night surveillance without additional light sources
- IP67 protection rating — full protection against dust and water jets

## Applications
- Shops and shopping centers — wireless installation without renovation work
- Offices and business centers — high-resolution video surveillance without cable routing
- Private residences — security of the perimeter and entrance groups
- Sites with historic facades — installation without drilling and chasing
- Temporary venues and exhibitions — quick deployment and dismantling

## FAQ
Q: How detailed is the image at 4 MP resolution?
A: The 4 MP resolution (2560×1440 pixels) allows clearly distinguishing details of faces, clothing and license plates even with digital enlargement of the recording.
Q: Is a power cable required with a wireless connection?

Q: Does the camera work at night?

tr.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1430DS-SAW bullet IP kamera

## Avantajları
- 4 MP çözünürlük — Full HD'ye kıyasla iki kat daha fazla detay, bu da insanların ve araçların tanımlanmasını kolaylaştırır
- Dahili Wi-Fi — ağ kablosu döşemeden kurulum, herhangi bir tesiste hızlı montaj

- Ofisler ve iş merkezleri — kablo tesisatı olmadan yüksek çözünürlüklü video gözetim
- Özel konutlar — çevrenin ve giriş gruplarının güvenliği
- Tarihi cepheli tesisler — delme ve kanal açma olmadan montaj
- Geçici alanlar ve fuarlar — hızlı kurulum ve sökme

## FAQ
Q: 4 MP çözünürlükte görüntü ne kadar detaylı görünür?
A: 4 MP çözünürlük (2560×1440 piksel) yüzlerin, kıyafetlerin ve plakaların detaylarını dijital büyütmede bile net şekilde ayırt etmeye olanak tanır.
Q: Kablosuz bağlantıda güç kablosu gerekir mi?
A: Evet, Wi-Fi ağ kablosu gerekliliğini ortadan kaldırır, ancak 12 V güç kablosunun yine de kameraya getirilmesi gerekir.

A: Evet, dahili IR aydınlatma karanlık saatlerde gözetim sağlar.

zh.name: Dahua IPC-HFW1430DS-SAW 筒型 IP 摄像机

zh.description:

## 优势
- 400 万像素分辨率 —— 相比全高清细节翻倍，便于识别人员和车辆
- 内置 Wi-Fi —— 无需布设网络线缆即可安装，在任何场所快速部署
- H.265 编码器 —— 保持画质的同时高度压缩，节省档案空间
- 1/3 英寸 CMOS 传感器 —— 对光线高灵敏，在不同光照条件下画面清晰
- 内置红外补光 —— 无需额外光源即可夜间监控
- IP67 防护等级 —— 完全防尘防水柱

## 应用领域
- 商店和购物中心 —— 无需施工的无线安装
- 办公室和商务中心 —— 无需布线的高分辨率视频监控
- 私人住宅 —— 守卫周界和出入口群
- 历史立面的建筑 —— 无需钻孔和开槽即可安装
- 临时场地和展会 —— 快速部署和拆除

## FAQ
Q: 400 万像素分辨率下画面细节有多清晰？

Q: 无线连接时需要电源线吗？
